query:
The group voted to go to the Peak District on November 8th and everyone registered some form of agreement. What did one member's response to that decision signal about how they actually felt, and what specifically in how they responded tells you that?

Options:
A. Jonah
B. Priya
C. Dev
D. Simone
context:
[1] (about=Marcus, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:38:00) A city trip is a reasonable counterproposal. We can vote in January. For now the Kinder Scout faction wins on points. Anyway. Simone, I wanted to check in. You were a bit quiet on the train back. You alright?
[2] (about=Jonah, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:43:00) ok. Singapore. SINGAPORE. Simone that is. ok that's massive. I did not see that coming. wait, Marcus did you know
[3] (about=Jonah, episodic, t12 @2025-11-16T20:17:00) ok unrelated but I've been thinking about Simone's thing and I keep landing on the same place. like, she just did it. no half measures, no checking if it felt right. just decided and went. that takes something
[4] (about=Simone, episodic, t10 @2025-11-09T19:42:00) Three weeks. I told Priya the same day I signed but I wanted to get the notice sorted before I said anything here. It felt wrong to tell the group before I'd made it official.
[5] (about=Jonah, core, t1 @2025-10-12T17:45:00) Proposing a November Peak District hike from Edale, a 14km route above Kinder Scout, not too steep with incredible views; asking who's in.
[6] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t10 @2025-11-09T19:31:00) Group decided to vote on a city trip in January as a counterproposal; for now the Kinder Scout faction wins on points.
[7] (about=Priya, core, t2 @2025-10-12T17:46:00) Hesitant about November Peak District hike due to mud; considers 14km in November mud a survival exercise, not a walk.
[8] (about=Simone, episodic, t2 @2025-10-12T18:01:00) You mentioned it when we were still in the flat. I'm aware of the seating plan reputation.
agent_answer:
D. Simone

Her response to the group’s Peak District decision was being quiet on the train back — Marcus noticed and checked in on her. She then revealed she had already signed to move to Singapore three weeks earlier, had only told Priya, and was waiting to make it official before telling the group because she felt it was wrong to announce it prematurely. That quietness plus the secret/hidden commitment signaled she was not fully present in the group’s decision — she had already emotionally moved on to something much bigger.

query:

[7] (about=Jonah, core, t2 @2025-10-12T17:46:00) Proposed 8th-9th November hike, found a bunkhouse in Hope village sleeping six at £18 per head per night with a proper kitchen.
[8] (about=GROUP, said_by=Jonah, group-interaction, t4 @2025-10-19T19:15:00) Jonah asks to settle in advance which pub is near the bunkhouse in Hope for post-hike priorities.
[9] (about=Marcus, core, t10 @2025-11-09T19:31:00) Says the Kinder Scout hike weekend was the best Saturday of the year, with 14km, ridge views, log fire, and pints.
[10] (about=Marcus, core, t6 @2025-10-26T18:01:00) Actually booked the bunkhouse for the hike; confirmation email sent to everyone including Simone.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t4 @2025-10-19T19:15:00) Group decided to have dinner on Saturday the 25th after the Peak District hike, at a different Italian place that is actually quiet, to debrief.
[12] (about=Priya, core, t4 @2025-10-19T19:15:00) Agrees to do the pub after the hike as long as nobody forces her back up a hill on Sunday morning.
[13] (about=Priya, core, t2 @2025-10-12T17:46:00) Agrees to join the hike if it doesn't clash with 'the thing', but demands someone buy her proper waterproof trousers if her jeans get destroyed.
[14] (about=Simone, core, t2 @2025-10-12T17:46:00) In for the hike assuming she can confirm by end of week; needs exact dates locked down and asks to confirm by Friday at the latest.
agent_answer:
**D. Priya.**

Priya’s agreement to the post-hike pub visit came with the condition: **“as long as nobody forces her back up a hill on Sunday morning.”**

That phrasing signals her actual attitude toward the trip: she was **not enthusiastic about the hiking itself** and saw it as something to be endured rather than enjoyed. The conditional “as long as” shows the pub was acceptable only if she wouldn’t have to do **more hill walking** afterward. In other words, her real priority was **avoiding the hills**, not the hike — the pub was the part she actually wanted.

query:
When Marcus asked the group to confirm plans for New Year, one member responded in a way that had become a recognisable pattern across multiple sessions. What did that response reveal about how they actually approach group commitments, and what in how they phrased it — across the whole conversation — makes that visible?

Options:
A. Jonah
B. Dev
C. Marcus
D. Priya
context:
[1] (about=Jonah, episodic, t13 @2025-11-23T19:15:00) right so Marcus it's nearly December and you have not mentioned the trivia night and I need to know if we're doing this or if 2025 is the year the institution dies
[2] (about=Marcus, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) I've been writing the question cards. I have a full round on post-war European history and a wildcard round I'm calling 'did this actually happen or did Jonah make it up'. The institution will not die.
[3] (about=Jonah, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:33:00) I'm in for the 30th. also Priya the 'city trip I'm planning' is very much your villain origin story for the next group argument. I respect it. tbf if it's a good city I'm not against it for the spring
[4] (about=Jonah, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:17:00) the wildcard round is a defamation risk but I respect the commitment. when and where
[5] (about=Marcus, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:31:00) You're welcome to join us, Jonah. Dev and I are doing a twelve-kilometre trail route on the 30th. No Priya, obviously. She's been formally excused on medical grounds.
[6] (about=Jonah, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:29:00) ok can we also discuss the fact that Marcus has been doing long runs without telling anyone and now wants to rope Dev in. Dev how far did you actually run on the descent at Kinder Scout because it looked like a full race pace
[7] (about=Jonah, episodic, t14 @2025-11-23T19:30:00) Dev and Marcus are now a trail running duo and no one told me. I am genuinely hurt. I have been evangelising this group for countryside stuff for YEARS and Dev just quietly became the athlete
[8] (about=Jonah, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T18:54:00) THREE TIMES. Dev I have been trying to get people to do trail runs with me for literally two years. the canal is just a warmup?? what does that even mean for next Saturday
[9] (about=Jonah, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T18:58:00) ok in fairness I did not absorb any of that. Marcus is doing a half marathon, that is actually news. when's the race
[10] (about=Jonah, episodic, t8 @2025-11-02T19:03:00) ok this is actually perfect, Dev and Marcus doing the fast bit up front, me and Jonah in the middle being correct about hiking, Priya and Simone forming an orderly rear guard. we will all meet at the pub and it will be beautiful
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Jonah, group-interaction, t4 @2025-10-19T19:15:00) Jonah asks to settle in advance which pub is near the bunkhouse in Hope for post-hike priorities.
[12] (about=GROUP, said_by=Marcus, group-interaction, t14 @2025-11-23T19:16:00) Group needs to confirm New Year plans by Friday so Marcus can make a booking.
[13] (about=GROUP, said_by=Simone, group-interaction, t0 @2025-10-05T18:30:00) Group agreed to have dinner at the new Italian place on Renfield Street on Friday; confirm by Wednesday.
agent_answer:
**A. Jonah**

When Marcus pushed the group to confirm New Year plans, Jonah’s reply shows that he approaches group commitments with **enthusiasm but also loose, conditional, side-tracking engagement** — he confirms, but immediately adds banter and hedged future options rather than giving a clean, firm “yes.”

This is visible in the phrasing across the conversation. To Marcus’s invitation, Jonah says:  
**“I’m in for the 30th. also Priya the ‘city trip I’m planning’ is very much your villain origin story... tbf if it’s a good city I’m not against it for the spring.”**  
So he commits to the 30th, but the next breath pivots to a different topic and leaves another option open with “if it’s a good city I’m not against it.”

The same pattern appears earlier: responding to Marcus’s trivia plan with **“the wildcard round is a defamation risk but I respect the commitment. when and where”** — a joke plus a request for more details rather than a straightforward confirmation. And with the trail-run talk: **“THREE TIMES... what does that even mean for next Saturday”** and **“ok this is actually perfect... we will all meet at the pub and it will be beautiful.”**

So Jonah’s response reveals someone who is **enthusiastically involved, but treats group plans as material for jokes, side-observations, and conditional “maybe”s** rather than as clean, binding commitments.
